environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on an EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer with no WAF association. The service runs as root in a Docker container with the host filesystem mounted at /var/app. No path validation beyond stripping leading slashes. The ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 directly to the target group on port 8080.

config.network: ALB -> Target Group port 8080, no WAF attached
config.alb_rules: Default action: forward to target group
config.container_security: No seccomp, no AppArmor, privileged mode
